title: How do occupational therapists at Pinnacle handle children who are non-verbal?
metaTitle: Handling Non-Verbal Communication in Children - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms Network's occupational therapists tailor-fit communication strategies for children who are non-verbal, bridging the communication gap for effective therapy.
html: Our empathetic occupational therapists at Pinnacle Blooms Network understand the unique challenges that come with non-verbal communication. That's why we offer a range of communication strategies tailor-fit to each child. Using tools like the Picture Exchange Communication System (PECS), sign language, and assistive technology, we find ways to bridge the communication gap, enabling children to express themselves in ways best suited for them.
